dotsBasis: Dots only where a distance is measured, not kinematic: trigonometric maser parallaxes (Reid et al. 2019) and Cepheid period-luminosity distances (Skowron et al. 2019).

map.method: Hou & Han (2014), Sect. 3.1.4 and Eq. 2: every spiral tracer brightened by a Gaussian of width 0.2 kpc with the amplitude of its weight (Sect. 2.4), summed face-on. Their method, applied to their three tracer tables with the WISE HII regions (Anderson et al. 2014) and the maser parallaxes (Reid et al. 2019) added under the same weights.

display.note: Presentation only: the square root of the density, clipped at the 99.5th percentile of the covered disc, through the magma colour ramp, with that value as opacity.
